top_stories.title: Ahead of Karnataka SIR, Congress seeks printed copies of 2002 electoral rolls from EC | Bangalore News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **Karnataka Pradesh Congress Committee (KPCC)** has requested the **Election Commission of India (ECI)** for printed copies of 2002 electoral rolls and related documents ahead of the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) process. The request was made by Ramesh Babu, MLC and Chairman of the KPCC Media and Communication Department, who cited the need for comparative verification and effective participation in the SIR process.  The party aims to identify discrepancies and ensure accurate voter registration.

top_stories.title: How a ‘free gift’ call turned into 8-year consumer battle: Country Club ordered to refund man Rs 1.8 lakh | Legal News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: A Telangana consumer court has ordered **Country Club** to return Rs 1.8 lakh to Goud, a man who was persuaded to pay the sum in 2018 for a membership and plot under a promotional scheme. The court found that the company failed to deliver promised benefits and engaged in unfair trade practices by pressuring Goud into signing contracts without adequate time to read them.  The court also rejected **Country Club**’s argument that the payment was non-refundable, noting that such clauses are not automatically exempt from consumer forum scrutiny. The ruling is a significant victory for consumers who have been misled by similar sales pitches in the past.

top_stories.title: Delhi data centre fire may have destroyed equipment worth hundreds of crores - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: A fire at a data center in Delhi's Greater Kailash on June 5, 2026, caused significant damage to equipment and disrupted internet services for several companies, including Google, Netflix, and local internet service providers. The blaze, which started in the battery room of the facility owned by **Tata Communications Ltd**, impacted at least two local networks and resulted in estimated losses of hundreds of crores of rupees.  **STT Telemedia GDC**, which leased the premises, is currently under review to determine the cause of the fire and assess the extent of the damage. The Delhi Fire Service deployed ten tenders to control the blaze, but it was eventually confined to the third floor.

top_stories.title: Kerala government considering comprehensive prison reforms: Ramesh Chennithala - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Home Minister Ramesh Chennithala** announced plans to overhaul Kerala's prison system, including potentially adding a new central prison due to overcrowding.  He also emphasized the need for increased staff and strengthened production units within prisons. The discussion focused on initiatives like chapatti manufacturing and petrol pumps that generate revenue for prison development. **Chennithala** extended the inquiry into prisoner escapes during the previous LDF government's tenure, while stating prisoners would not be granted parole based solely on political grounds.

top_stories.title: Nepal to reopen probe into royal palace massacre of 2001 - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Nepal's** new Home Minister, Sudan Gurung, announced the reopening of files related to the 2001 royal massacre.  The incident saw **King Birendra Shah** and his family killed by then-crown prince Dipendra at the Narayanhiti Royal Palace. An official probe commission had previously dismissed its report on Dipendra's actions, but Gurung has vowed to reopen the investigation.

top_stories.title: Daily Briefing: West Asia tensions hit India’s farms, exports and global supply chains | Live News - The Indian Express
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** has surpassed **Jawaharlal Nehru** to become India’s longest-serving elected Prime Minister, marking a significant milestone in the country's political history.  The BJP-led National Democratic Alliance (NDA) is celebrating 12 years of power at the Centre and will commemorate this achievement with a resolution congratulating Modi on his record. Meanwhile, global fertilizer shortages are straining India’s supply chains, potentially increasing subsidy burdens and impacting agricultural productivity. Additionally, geopolitical tensions in West Asia are causing shipping disruptions for Indian exporters, raising concerns about competitiveness in global markets.

top_stories.title: Awami members can fight local polls as independents - The Times of India
top_stories.rephrased_article: **The Tarique Rahman-led government** has announced that party members will be allowed to contest the upcoming local government elections in their individual capacities. **PM Zahed Ur Rahman** clarified that individuals holding party positions would be eligible, but using banned organization names or slogans during campaigning would be prohibited. The move comes amidst a resurgence of **Awami League** supporters and street processions despite its ban under anti-terrorism laws.  The government is expected to begin the phased rollout of local elections after the monsoon season, likely starting in September or October.

top_stories.title: Two soldiers killed in accidental grenade blast in Uri - The Hindu
top_stories.rephrased_article: **Two soldiers** died in an accidental grenade blast at a camp in Kamalkote, Uri sector of Baramulla district in Jammu and Kashmir on Tuesday. The incident occurred during routine equipment handover and resulted in injuries to the two jawans who were later declared dead upon arrival at the Army's 92 Base Hospital.  An inquest has been initiated.

top_stories.title: Asian stocks decline, oil prices gain as US hits Iran - The Economic Times
top_stories.rephrased_article: The **MSCI Asia Pacific Index** fell 0.5% as technology stocks continued to decline, following a rebound on Tuesday.  The **Kospi Index** in South Korea dropped 1.7%, while the **Nikkei** in Japan also declined. The **S&P 500** and **Nasdaq 100** indexes were little changed after volatile sessions on Tuesday. Brent crude rose, pushing the dollar higher against other major currencies as tensions with **Iran** escalated. Investors now await Wednesday's US inflation data, which may influence the Federal Reserve's future interest rate decisions.
